tldr: Midday batch (Aug 27): the big one — Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $13B (~86× revenue, ~3× the 2023 valuation), ending HF neutrality and prompting 'mirror the weights' advice for anyone depending on the open-model hub. Anthropic opens its frontier research model to external researchers by application, Amazon shuts down Mechanical Turk after 21 years (the original human-in-the-loop pipeline, displaced by AI), HN's top story is an open-source 'AI CEO' born from AI-driven developer layoffs, and HF dogfoods open-weights Inkling-Small to summarize paper abstracts. Morning push already carried Qwen3.8-Flash, the HF incident post-mortem and GLM-5.3-Flash.

articles.title: Nvidia Agrees to Buy Hugging Face for $13B
articles.summary: The 'GitHub of AI' goes to Jensen at ~86× revenue, nearly 3× the 2023 valuation — a counterweight play to keep CUDA un-routable-around as closed labs build custom silicon.

articles.title: CEO Fired Developers for AI — So Devs Built an Open-Source AI CEO
articles.summary: HN's top story (158 pts): a community-built open-source AI executive agent, born as a direct response to AI-driven developer layoffs.

articles.title: Anthropic Opens Its Research Model to External Researchers
articles.summary: Anthropic is scaling its research model and taking applications (Google Form) for researchers doing advanced work not otherwise possible — frontier-scaling push with external input.

articles.title: Mechanical Turk Shuts Down Sept 30
articles.summary: Amazon ends its 21-year-old crowdsourcing platform — the original human-in-the-loop data pipeline, displaced by AI. Migrate MTurk workflows before Sept 30.

articles.title: Hugging Face Dogfoods Open-Weight Inkling-Small for Paper Summaries
articles.summary: HF turns paper abstracts into quick summaries with its own open-weights model — 'open weights × open science' in practice inside the platform itself.
